title: Trend Micro Apex Central Improper Authentication Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Trend Micro Apex Central. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the management console. The issue results from incorrect implementation of the authentication algorithm. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the user.
